design_decision.description: Clojure analyzer contract (CLJ waves, probe-verified 2026-09-19 against the pinned @yogthos/tree-sitter-clojure 0.0.14 wasm): the RULINGS below are load-bearing — each names the node types whose handling they govern.

decisions.question: Is `#Name[…]/#Name{…}` a constructor or a tagged reader literal?
decisions.resolution: RULED: shape + capitalization heuristic (AST cannot resolve classes): vec/map payload with a final UPPERCASE segment emits instantiates from the enclosing context (line = the tag name); anything else is reader DATA and its payload is NEVER walked as code (`#my/tag (call-x)` emits no call). Fixture tagged-ctors + mutants tag-payload-call/tag-lowercase-ctor.

decisions.question: Do reader conditionals trap code (cljc portability)?
decisions.resolution: RULED: the wrapper is transparent — children (`(expr)` bodies inside #? / #?@) are walked generically, so calls inside reader-conditional branches resolve; the wrapper emits nothing itself.

decisions.question: @x, #'f, and `~x`-style symbol-value reads: call edges?
decisions.resolution: RULED: NOT calls — a var quote/`sym_val_lit` names a var, a deref reads a value; none fabricate call edges (the member-access exclusion family, EX2 parity).

decisions.question: Literal containers as parameter/call sources?
decisions.resolution: RULED: containers are data positions — they emit no edges themselves; map_lit participates ONLY as a destructuring binding source in extractParams (:keys/:strs/:syms/:as/{local :key}; :or values are expressions, skipped). Fixture params + mutants param-body-leak/param-amp-kept.

decisions.question: Metadata positions and auto-resolved keywords: execution or trivia?
decisions.resolution: RULED: metadata occupies NO execution position (executionHead skips meta_lit — the #881 head rule, formally widened by the meta-head fixture) and never becomes a call; auto-resolved marks (`::k`) carry no call semantics; a `^:private`-wrapped name still resolves through the `name` field (shape-probed).

decisions.question: Method impls `(px [_] …)` inside reify/extend-type/extend-protocol/proxy/defrecord/deftype: calls or definitions?
decisions.resolution: RULED: DEFINITIONS — a direct list child of those forms is a method symbol owning its body's calls, emits NO call edge (the measured `use-reify -[calls]-> px` fabrication), and the parent form emits the implements/extends edges (extend-* source = the named TYPE; reify/proxy source = the enclosing context). Fixture extend-reify + mutants reify-false-call/reify-no-implements.

decisions.question: Top-level directive forms and def-initializer calls after the ns?
decisions.resolution: RULED: top-level `(require …)`/`(import …)`/`(use …)`/`(refer …)` parse through the same libspec handler as ns clauses (quoting_lit unwrapped; aliases registered, imports recorded, references edged at the libspec line); calls outside any function attribute to the NAMESPACE (meta.isTopLevel) — def/defonce initializers and deftest bodies included (deftest is a function symbol). Fixtures toplevel-forms/toplevel-calls + mutants directive-ignored/toplevel-call-dropped.
